mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, conversation_id, turn_id, request_id, mode, message, schema_json, status, answer_json, answer_protocol_version, dispatch_attempt, executor_id, answer_id, delivery_status, delivery_deadline, next_delivery_at, gmt_create, gmt_modified
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO agent_conversation_elicitation (tenant_id, conversation_id, turn_id, request_id, mode, message, schema_json, status, answer_protocol_version, dispatch_attempt, executor_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{conversationId}, #{turnId}, #{requestId}, #{mode}, #{message}, #{schemaJson}, #{status}, #{answerProtocolVersion}, #{dispatchAttempt}, #{executorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_conversation_elicitation SET delivery_status = #{stage}, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND answer_id = #{answerId} AND delivery_status IN ('SAVED','RECEIVED') AND (#{stage} IN ('WRITTEN','UNAVAILABLE','UNKNOWN') OR (#{stage} = 'RECEIVED' AND delivery_status = 'SAVED'))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_conversation_elicitation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status IN ('EXPIRED','CANCELED','ANSWERED','DECLINED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_conversation_elicitation SET next_delivery_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND answer_id = #{answerId} AND delivery_status IN ('UNKNOWN','UNAVAILABLE')
